craft_notes: Sthāyin: competence law. Sanskrit-first: fourfold mastery kept whole. Rows: 2. Close: evident. Rejected: shortening the compound — killed: the compound is the standard. Read aloud: weighing cadence.

lines: Master the four within; your rites will shine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yo gururjapahomārcādhyānasiddhatvamātmani | jñātvā dīkṣāṃ carettasya dīkṣā sapratyayā smṛtā
